notes.title: We're alive
notes.content:
It took some time but.. we are alive

[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/Gk0izKjWcAABmqy?format=jpg&name=4096x4096[/img]

Changes since version 0.77:
- Picking up of objects improved
- Battle improved
- Made Arena 74 a little nicer
- Added Training Arena and Arena 75
- Players can now get wounded or poisoned
